::: {#exm-simulation-bias-estimate}
#### A simulation estimate of the bias from three replications

<!-- no-figure: the example is a hand calculation with three numbers -->

Continue the [three replications](#exm-simulation-estimate), and let the [estimand](estimation.qmd#def-estimand) be $\param = 5$.
Then the [simulation estimate of the bias](#def-simulation-bias-estimate) is

$$\samplemean{T}{3} - \param = 4 - 5 = -1.$$
:::
